header.stance: 活動轉強，實質殖利率與短端同步上升

zh-TW.long_thesis_markdown:
## 經濟活動轉強，短端也加入美債賣壓

S&P Global指標顯示，美國企業活動以逾4年來最快速度擴張，帶動週五美債殖利率全面上升。2年與10年期各升5個基點，至4.24%與4.74%，30年期上升4個基點至5.27%。有別於週四賣壓集中在較長天期，這次對政策更敏感的短債也走弱。

10年期實質殖利率升至2.40%，占名目殖利率升幅的全部，損益兩平通膨率則維持2.34%。布蘭特原油繼續上漲，通膨補償卻未延續前一天升勢。企業活動轉強，使近期疲弱就業與零售資料所呈現的前景更複雜。S&P 500上漲0.43%，VIX降至15.13%，借款成本提高之際，風險偏好仍有韌性，並非資金全面撤出資產市場。

財政部擴大回購的承諾，未能阻止殖利率收復週三大部分降幅。財政措施仍未量化，AI融資熱潮則開始吸引傳統投資級市場以外的買家。高收益債投資人承接部分近期資料中心債，澳洲以退休基金支撐的市場也提供另一筆資金來源。但兩者都有容量限制，買家看的是收益與結構，不只是發行人的評等。

## 實質殖利率回升，能源風險尚未解除

5年期殖利率上升4個基點至4.43%。各天期升幅接近，使2年與10年期利差持平於50個基點，2年與30年期僅縮小1個基點至103個基點。30年期收盤追平週四盤中高點，較1個月前高14個基點。與週四相比，差別在於實質殖利率及短端上升，而不是通膨補償再度推動曲線轉陡。

Goldman Sachs認為，連續出現溫和通膨資料，仍是殖利率持續下降最明確的途徑。這可強化Fed維持利率不變的預期，降低利率上行風險。近期就業、零售與核心物價提供一些支持，但週五企業調查也說明，單一組疲弱資料並不足夠。部分消費與就業轉弱時，企業活動及投資仍可能保持強勁。

週五收盤後，明尼阿波利斯Fed總裁Neel Kashkari在週日談話中表示，美債市場運作良好，殖利率升高不太可能改變以聯邦基金利率為中心的政策討論。他是七月3名主張升息25個基點的反對票之一，仍擔心通膨持續，但未承諾九月會再次要求升息。這番話顯示，只要市場交易有序，債券價格下跌本身並不足以促使Fed回應。

油價仍包含地緣政治風險溢價。布蘭特上漲0.65%至$94.39，近1週漲幅達6.63%，WTI則下跌0.88%至$87.06。伊朗總統Masoud Pezeshkian呼籲結束持續6個月的戰爭，較強硬官員卻傾向繼續作戰。油價在談話後短暫回落，隨即反彈。川普政府也正準備針對伊朗及其貿易夥伴的經濟孤立方案，最大伊朗原油買家中國可能受到影響。不過，這些消息並未讓當日10年期損益兩平通膨率進一步上升。

Baker Hughes總鑽井數由593座降至588座。鑽井減少可能影響產業日後增產的能力，但不是當下產量損失的直接衡量。布蘭特與WTI走勢分歧，也提醒不同原油市場承受的供給壓力並不完全相同。

Nasdaq 100上漲0.33%，VIX下跌5.50%。HYG與JNK分別上漲0.06%與0.10%，LQD則下跌0.13%。利率上升並未造成風險資產同步下跌。

## 調整到期結構，借款需求仍在

貝森特將策略稱為「財政部扭轉操作」：回購長債，以較短期借款支應。這能降低民間持有的久期，也可改善舊券流動性，但同時讓再融資日期更接近。它與央行量化寬鬆不同，並不創造準備金來買債。

截至週五，最初的價格反應已大幅消退。10年期殖利率接近貝森特就任以來最高，30年期也仍高於Bank of America策略師Michael Hartnett認為關乎政策持續性的5%水準。財政部在例行融資指引公布僅兩週後改變計畫，若之後再出現意外調整，即使個別回購有助支撐價格，投資人對未來供給仍可能更不確定。

財政收支的規模遠大於操作金額。聯邦收入約$5.5兆、支出約$7.5兆，年度缺口約$2兆；利息支出已超過$1兆，約$10兆債務需要再融資。赤字接近GDP的6%，公共債務突破$40兆。減少詐欺、降低對州政府移轉、關稅及成長等方向，截至收盤仍未形成量化方案。社會安全保障、Medicare及Medicaid仍是主要結構性支出來源，短期內改革相關福利制度的政治可能性很低。

交易資料也未顯示市場運作需要緊急救援。美債成交額為$9,797億，其中一般附息公債$8,324億，較週四減少18.1%；20年以上成交額減少35.8%至$885億。交易商與客戶之間的交易，占全部附息公債面額42.4%，最長天期為43.5%。這些是成交量，不是淨買賣；交投在前幾日放量後降溫，並未消失。

黃金上漲2.39%至$4,624.10，近1個月漲幅達13.58%；美元指數下跌0.10%至98.8，同期下跌2.35%。這與市場對「財政方案尚未明朗，就先壓低名目借款成本」的疑慮相符，但美元今年以來跌幅仍有限。比特幣當週上漲約23%、接近$77,500，同時有近$25億空頭部位遭清算，空單回補是其漲勢的重要因素。

Fed與財政部的任務不同。Warsh重視市場價格傳遞的資訊，以及長期利率升高帶來的緊縮效果；財政部則希望降低其認為偏離基本面的借款成本。擴大回購是否足以放鬆金融情勢，要看規模與持續時間，單純縮短債務到期年限，無法解決Fed的通膨問題。

## AI發債吸引跨級別買家，也考驗澳洲市場容量

企業今年已為資料中心及相關AI投資借入逾$4,100億。近期專案債同時進入投資級與高收益債投資組合：承銷商將QTS與Microsoft相關的喬治亞州設施融資$39億、殖利率約7.23%，以及BlackRock七月德州案、殖利率7.53%的債券，分銷給兩類買家。投資級評等打開一組客群，足夠高的收益又吸引另一組。

額外需求並非無限。美國高收益債市場約$1.5兆，不到投資級的五分之一，經理人若要建立大型新部位，可能得在流動性偏薄時出售既有投機級持債。專案債仍取決於完工、集中租約及資產殘值。Oracle與SpaceX的高評等債券，次級市場殖利率已達垃圾債常見水準，意味未來發行也可能需要更高補償。對必須等待多年才有專案現金流的小型借款人，資金成本上升尤其不利。

Alphabet澳幣債提供了更具體的容量觀察。這筆A$55億、澳洲最大公司債交易中，QIC申購A$3億，最終獲配約A$1.7億，但仍判斷當地市場每年大概只能承接兩筆左右的同等規模交易。外國借款人今年Kangaroo債發行已超過A$640億，澳幣債市規模自2022年10月低點成長近40%，達A$2.14兆。退休基金需求持續深化，卻無法以超大型雲端業者需要的規模，取代美元與歐元市場。

Alphabet今年已透過美元、加幣、澳幣、瑞郎、歐元及日圓等市場發行逾$800億債務，也包括罕見的£10億100年期債。公司資本支出計畫最高$2,050億，美國最大幾家超大型雲端業者至2030年的合計支出可能達$6兆。澳洲3年期公債期貨未平倉量已升至140萬口，接近2008年143萬口紀錄，政府與企業債務增加也提高避險需求。未平倉量本身不代表部位方向。

南韓出口商則從同一投資循環取得大量現金。八月上旬按工作日調整後的出口年增61.5%，半導體增198.8%，電腦相關產品增242.1%。貿易順差接近$140億，六月經常帳順差也創$497億紀錄。整體通膨雖降至2.8%，核心卻加速至2.6%，在七月一致決議升息25個基點至2.75%後，仍支持央行維持緊縮傾向。

Samsung與SK Hynix已將部分強勁現金流用於投資及股東分配。依六月達成的多年國家計畫，兩家公司將至少投入₩1,350兆發展晶片與資料中心。Samsung今年預計最高回饋股東$790億，資本支出逾$730億；SK Hynix編列至少$310億資本支出，增加50%。目前出口足以支撐承諾，但若AI循環放緩仍要維持投入，現金調度空間將減少。

## 日本預算增加供給不確定性，歐洲通膨細節轉緩

日本七月服務通膨小幅升至1.2%，汽油稅調降則使整體通膨少了0.22個百分點。扣除生鮮食品CPI上升1.8%，能源價格增加0.6%。進口成本與企業轉嫁價格的力道增強之際，行政減負措施壓低了實際公布的物價漲幅。市場反映9月18日日本央行升息機率約80%，日圓約在每美元158.91。

四月開始的新會計年度預算申請，可能超過前次¥122兆紀錄；計算債務成本使用的暫定利率，也可能由2.6%提高至3.8%。目前債務支出已占預算四分之一，殖利率上升正逐步進入政府自身的支出估算。

但預算總額將更難直接比較，因為首相高市早苗打算將經常性項目從補充預算移至初始預算。去年補充規模為¥18.3兆，經產省在初始約¥8,510億之外，又增加逾¥2兆。另有多年架構支應高市的¥370兆、14年成長策略，容許在一般上限外提出需求，透過特別會計及有專款支持的過橋債籌資。把支出提前列入初始預算可以提高透明度，不代表總支出等額增加；最終發債與過橋融資安排，才會決定實際供給。

歐元區七月家庭1年期通膨預期由3%降至2.9%，3年期由2.8%降至2.7%。第二季協議工資成長由修正後的2.56%降至2.44%，遠低於2024年5.55%高峰。即使當前通膨接近3%，這些細節顯示能源成本轉為持續國內物價壓力的跡象減弱。

ECB管委Martins Kazaks表示，通膨水準有些令人不安，央行也已準備好採取行動，但九月是否升息仍各有理由。經濟成長有韌性，工資卻放緩、預期也受控。市場幾乎確定會升息25個基點，他的措辭仍保留條件。

瑞士距離緊縮更遠。SNB決策官員Petra Tschudin表示，若為維持0%至2%的通膨區間所需，利率可以降至零以下。目前政策利率已為零，即使全球能源成本上升，七月通膨仍僅0.4%。第二季成長高於預期與工資上升，使展望較複雜，但負利率仍是可用工具。

## 恆大資產追索更複雜，Braskem接近重整期限

中國法院判處恆大創辦人許家印無期徒刑、沒收資產，並對其公司合計處以CNY158億罰款。清算人正代表約有$450億債務的公司，追索許家印全球約$77億資產，如今可能與中國境內執法程序競逐。

中國法律原則上讓賠償及償債優先於罰款與沒收，但資產分配及跨境執行仍不確定。香港清算人尚未在對許家印的訴訟中勝訴，外國法院也不必自動將中國判決執行於海外資產。境外債價格仍低於面額2%，而2023年估計的平均清算回收率為3.4%。判決使取得資產的程序更複雜，並未明顯改善市場對回收的預期。

Braskem面臨更近的期限。債權人提出的非約束性方案包含注資及擔保權益，但在8月24日暫緩執行期屆滿前仍未達成協議。墨西哥子公司已在美國提出預先協議式破產案；母公司若要進行庭外重整，需取得至少三分之一債務持有人支持，之後各方再有90天完成條款。

Elliott、Contrarian等債權人要求控制股東Petrobras提供股本、營運資金或次順位債，Petrobras則考慮改善合約付款條件。Braskem的2031年美元債殖利率約23%。新增擔保品可能提高參與債權人的保障，卻使無擔保持有人相對落後；股東資金則可能維持營運。協議仍須確定誰投入新價值，以及取得何種順位。

## PCE、財政細節與Jackson Hole接續登場

8月26日公布的七月PCE，將檢驗近期溫和核心通膨能否延續。消費穩定而價格壓力受控，將支持Goldman對殖利率較持久回落的看法。伊朗政策、實際油輪運輸及運費與保險成本，仍影響進口壓力是否擴散。週五2年期殖利率上升，10年期損益兩平通膨率卻不動；若兩者同步上升，通膨訊號就會不同。

貝森特的財政方案若要超越到期結構調整，需要量化收入、支出與現金借款的改變。Warsh在8月28日Jackson Hole的談話，則將釐清Fed如何看待長期利率、財政部干預及經濟數據。截至週五收盤，具體財政方案與Fed立場轉變都尚未確立。

下一批AI融資將實際檢驗投資人容量。最終定價、保證、擔保品、租約集中度，以及投資級、高收益、銀行與私募資本之間的配置，可看出借款人如何分配風險。殖利率逾7%仍能吸引大量訂單，代表資金尚可取得，卻也顯示專案付出不低的成本；交易縮小或聯貸分銷延後，則意味投資速度面臨更緊的融資限制。

overall_summary.headline: 企業活動轉強，美債賣壓擴及短端
overall_summary.session_narrative:
S&P Global顯示企業活動以逾4年來最快速度擴張。10年期實質殖利率升至2.40%，損益兩平通膨率維持2.34%，30年期收在5.27%。短端加入賣壓，曲線卻未再明顯轉陡。

股市上漲，VIX降至15.13%。財政提案仍未量化，財政部調整到期結構帶來的初始價格效果已大幅消退。Kashkari稍後的週日談話強調市場運作正常，通膨疑慮仍在。

AI專案債同時吸引投資級與高收益買家；QIC的Alphabet獲配情況顯示澳洲需求強，但容量有限。南韓出口大增、日本預算不確定，歐洲工資與通膨預期放緩卻與幾乎確定的升息定價形成落差。恆大與Braskem則各有債權保障問題。

long_thesis.english_markdown:
## Stronger activity brings the front end into the selloff

Treasury yields rose across the curve on Friday after S&P Global gauges showed US business activity expanding at its fastest pace in more than four years. Two- and 10-year yields each increased 5 basis points, to 4.24% and 4.74%, while the 30-year rose 4 basis points to 5.27%. Unlike Thursday, when selling was concentrated beyond the front end, policy-sensitive debt joined the move.

Real yields supplied the entire 10-year increase, rising to 2.40%, while the breakeven held at 2.34%. Brent advanced again, but inflation compensation did not extend the previous day's rise. Stronger activity had complicated the outlook suggested by recent weak employment and retail data. The S&P 500 gained 0.43% and VIX fell to 15.13, leaving higher borrowing costs alongside resilient risk appetite rather than a broad rush out of assets.

Treasury's expanded buyback promise had not prevented yields from recovering most of Wednesday's decline. Fiscal measures remained unquantified, while the AI funding boom was reaching beyond traditional investment-grade buyers. High-yield investors helped absorb recent data-center bonds, and Australia's pension-backed market offered another source of capital. Both have limits: buyers are responding to the yields and structures on offer, not simply the issuers' ratings.

## Real yields rise while energy risk stays unresolved

Five-year yields rose 4 basis points to 4.43%. With similar moves across maturities, 2s10s was unchanged at 50 basis points and 2s30s narrowed just 1 to 103. The 30-year close matched Thursday's intraday high and stood 14 basis points above its level a month earlier. The change from Thursday was the rise in real yields and the front end, rather than another steepening driven by inflation compensation.

Goldman Sachs argued that a sustained sequence of benign inflation readings remains the clearest route to lower yields. That would strengthen confidence in an on-hold Fed and reduce the risk of higher rates. Recent jobs, retail and underlying inflation releases offered some support, but Friday's business survey showed why one weak set of data was insufficient. Activity and investment can remain strong even as parts of consumption and employment soften.

Speaking on Sunday, after the Friday close, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said Treasury markets were functioning well and higher yields were unlikely to change deliberations centered on the federal funds rate. He had been one of three July dissenters favoring a 25-basis-point increase. He remained concerned about persistent inflation but did not commit to another call for a hike in September. His comments indicated that orderly bond-market losses alone would not prompt a policy response.

Oil retained a geopolitical premium. Brent rose 0.65% to $94.39, bringing its weekly gain to 6.63%, while WTI fell 0.88% to $87.06. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian urged an end to the six-month war, but harder-line officials favored continuing it. Oil briefly dipped on his remarks before recovering. The Trump administration was also preparing an economic-isolation plan aimed at Iran and its trading partners, including the risk to China as the largest buyer of Iranian crude. None of that produced a further daily rise in the 10-year breakeven.

The Baker Hughes total rig count fell to 588 from 593. Fewer rigs may affect the industry's ability to respond over time; the count is not a measure of an immediate production loss. The split between Brent and WTI likewise cautioned against treating all crude supply as subject to the same pressure.

Nasdaq 100 rose 0.33%, while VIX declined 5.50%. HYG and JNK gained 0.06% and 0.10%, respectively, even as LQD fell 0.13%. The market absorbed higher rates without a common decline across risky assets.

## A maturity switch leaves the borrowing requirement intact

Bessent called the strategy a “Treasury twist”: repurchase longer-dated debt and finance the operations with shorter borrowing. It reduces the duration private investors hold and can improve liquidity in older securities, but it also brings refinancing dates closer. Unlike central-bank quantitative easing, it does not create reserves to buy bonds.

The immediate price response had largely unwound by Friday. Ten-year yields closed near their highest since Bessent took office, and the 30-year remained above the 5% level Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett viewed as important to the effort's durability. Treasury had changed the plan only two weeks after its regular financing guidance. Further surprise changes could leave investors less certain about supply, even when each individual purchase supports prices.

The fiscal arithmetic is much larger than the operations. Federal revenue is running near $5.5 trillion and spending near $7.5 trillion, leaving an annual shortfall around $2 trillion. Interest expense is already above $1 trillion and roughly $10 trillion of debt needs refinancing. The deficit is near 6% of GDP and public debt exceeds $40 trillion. Fraud reduction, lower transfers to states, tariffs and growth had not been turned into a quantified package by the close. Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid remain major structural spending drivers, with near-term entitlement reform politically remote.

Trading gave little indication of a market-functioning emergency. Treasury turnover totaled $979.7 billion, including $832.4 billion of nominal coupons, down 18.1% for coupons from Thursday. Beyond-20-year activity fell 35.8% to $88.5 billion. Dealer-to-customer trades represented 42.4% of all coupon par value and 43.5% in the longest bucket. These figures describe turnover, not net buying or selling; activity had moderated after the earlier surge rather than disappeared.

Gold gained 2.39% to $4,624.10, up 13.58% over a month, while the dollar index slipped 0.10% to 98.8 and was down 2.35% over that period. Those moves are consistent with concern about lowering nominal borrowing costs before a fiscal plan is visible, although the dollar's decline this year remained modest. Bitcoin's roughly 23% weekly rise toward $77,500 also included nearly $2.5 billion of bearish liquidations, making short covering an important part of that move.

The Fed and Treasury are pursuing different tasks. Warsh has emphasized the information in market prices and the restraint from higher long rates. Treasury wants to lower borrowing costs it considers out of line with fundamentals. Whether larger buybacks meaningfully ease financial conditions will depend on their scale and persistence; shortening maturities by itself does not resolve the Fed's inflation problem.

## AI borrowers draw crossover buyers and test Australia's capacity

Companies have borrowed more than $410 billion for data centers and related AI investment this year. Recent project bonds are reaching both investment-grade and high-yield buyers: underwriters distributed QTS's $3.9 billion Microsoft-linked Georgia financing, yielding about 7.23%, and BlackRock's July Texas securities at 7.53% across both groups. Investment-grade ratings gave access to one set of portfolios, while the yields attracted another.

That extra demand is not unlimited. The US high-yield market is about $1.5 trillion, less than a fifth of high grade, and managers may have to sell existing speculative-grade holdings in thin liquidity to fund large new positions. Project bonds still depend on completion, concentrated leases and residual asset values. High-grade Oracle and SpaceX notes were already trading at yields associated with junk debt, suggesting that future issuance could also need higher compensation. A higher cost of capital weighs most heavily on smaller borrowers waiting years for a project's cash flow.

Alphabet's Australian deal offered a more specific view of local capacity. QIC received about A$170 million after bidding for A$300 million across the A$5.5 billion transaction, Australia's largest corporate bond sale. QIC nevertheless judged that the market could probably handle only a couple of comparable deals each year. Foreign borrowers' Kangaroo issuance has exceeded A$64 billion in 2026, and the Australian-dollar bond market has grown almost 40% from its October 2022 low to A$2.14 trillion. Pension demand is deepening, but it cannot replace the dollar and euro markets at the scale hyperscalers need.

Alphabet has issued more than $80 billion this year across US, Canadian and Australian dollars, Swiss francs, euros and yen, including a rare £1 billion 100-year bond. Its capex plan reaches $205 billion, and aggregate spending by the largest US hyperscalers could reach $6 trillion through 2030. Australian 3-year bond-futures open interest has risen to 1.4 million contracts, close to the 1.43 million record from 2008, as a larger government and corporate debt stock increases hedging needs. Open interest does not identify the direction of those positions.

Korean exporters are receiving substantial cash from the same investment cycle. Working-day-adjusted exports in early August rose 61.5% from a year earlier, led by 198.8% growth in semiconductors and 242.1% in computer-related products. The trade surplus approached $14 billion, after a record $49.7 billion current-account surplus in June. Core inflation accelerated to 2.6% even as the headline rate eased to 2.8%, supporting a tightening bias after July's unanimous 25-basis-point increase to 2.75%.

Samsung and SK Hynix have committed much of that strength to investment and distributions. Under a multi-year national plan agreed in June, they will invest at least ₩1,350 trillion in chips and data centers. Samsung expects shareholder returns of as much as $79 billion this year and capex above $73 billion; SK Hynix earmarked at least $31 billion of capex, up 50%. Current exports support those commitments, but maintaining them would leave less cash flexibility if the AI cycle slows.

## Japan's budget adds supply uncertainty as European inflation details soften

Japan's July services inflation edged up to 1.2%, while a gasoline tax cut subtracted 0.22 percentage point from overall inflation. CPI excluding fresh food rose 1.8% and energy prices increased 0.6%. Administrative relief was holding down the measured increase as imported costs and corporate pass-through strengthened. Markets assigned about an 80% chance to a September 18 BOJ hike, with the yen near 158.91 per dollar.

Budget requests for the fiscal year beginning in April are likely to exceed the previous ¥122 trillion record. The provisional interest rate used to calculate debt costs may rise to 3.8% from 2.6%, and debt service already takes a quarter of the current budget. Higher yields are therefore entering the government's own spending estimates.

The headline request will be harder to compare because Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi plans to move recurring items from supplementary budgets into the initial plan. Last year's supplement was ¥18.3 trillion; the trade ministry alone added more than ¥2 trillion after an initial allocation of about ¥851 billion. A separate multi-year framework for Takaichi's ¥370 trillion, 14-year growth strategy will permit requests outside normal caps, using a special account and bridge bonds backed by dedicated sources. Moving expenditure into the first budget can improve transparency without increasing total spending by the same amount. Final issuance and the bridge-financing arrangements will determine the bond supply.

In the euro area, households' one-year inflation expectation fell to 2.9% in July from 3%, and the three-year measure to 2.7% from 2.8%. Negotiated wage growth slowed to 2.44% in the second quarter from a revised 2.56%, far below the 5.55% peak in 2024. These details showed less evidence of energy costs feeding into persistent domestic inflation, even with current inflation near 3%.

ECB Governing Council member Martins Kazaks called inflation somewhat uncomfortable and said the bank was well positioned to act, but saw arguments on both sides of a September increase. Resilient growth sat alongside slowing wages and anchored expectations. Markets were nearly certain of a 25-basis-point hike; his language remained conditional.

Swiss policy was further from tightening. SNB policymaker Petra Tschudin said rates could fall below zero if needed to keep inflation within the 0%–2% range. The policy rate is already zero and July inflation was only 0.4% despite higher global energy costs. Stronger-than-expected second-quarter growth and rising wages complicate that outlook, but the option of negative rates remains available.

## Evergrande's asset pursuit becomes more complex; Braskem nears a deadline

A mainland court sentenced Evergrande founder Hui Ka Yan to life imprisonment, ordered his assets confiscated and fined his companies a combined CNY15.8 billion. Liquidators are pursuing roughly $7.7 billion of his worldwide assets on behalf of a company with about $45 billion of debt. Mainland enforcement proceedings could now compete with that effort.

Chinese law in principle puts compensation and debt repayment ahead of fines and confiscation, but distribution and cross-border enforcement remain uncertain. Hong Kong liquidators have not yet won their case against Hui, and foreign courts do not automatically have to enforce the mainland judgment against overseas assets. Offshore notes remained below 2 cents on the dollar, against an average recovery estimate of 3.4% made in 2023. The ruling complicated the route to assets without materially improving market expectations for recovery.

Braskem faced a nearer deadline. Non-binding creditor proposals included capital injections and security interests, but no agreement had been reached before the August 24 expiry of its enforcement stay. Its Mexican unit had already filed a prepackaged US bankruptcy case. The parent needs support from holders of at least one-third of its debt for an out-of-court restructuring, which would then give the parties another 90 days to finalize terms.

Elliott, Contrarian and other creditors pressed controlling shareholder Petrobras for equity, working capital or junior debt; Petrobras was considering improved payment terms on contracts. Braskem's 2031 dollar bonds yielded about 23%. New collateral could help participating creditors while leaving unsecured holders behind, whereas sponsor funding could preserve operations. The agreement still has to settle who contributes new value and what priority that contribution receives.

## PCE, fiscal detail and Jackson Hole set the next policy sequence

July PCE on August 26 will test whether the recent benign underlying inflation readings can persist. Stable consumption with contained price pressure would support Goldman's argument for more durable yield relief. Iran policy, actual oil shipments and freight and insurance costs remain relevant to whether imported pressure spreads. On Friday, the 2-year yield rose while the 10-year breakeven did not; simultaneous increases would present a different inflation signal.

Bessent's fiscal initiative needs quantified changes to revenue, spending and cash borrowing if it is to do more than shift maturities. Warsh's August 28 Jackson Hole remarks will then clarify how the Fed views higher long rates, Treasury intervention and the underlying data. Neither a fiscal package nor a change in the Fed's position had been established by the Friday close.

The next AI financings will provide a practical measure of investor capacity. Final pricing, guarantees, collateral, lease concentration and allocations among IG, high yield, banks and private capital will show how borrowers are sharing the risk. Large orders at yields above 7% would keep funding available, but still leave projects paying substantially for it. Smaller transactions or delayed syndication would point to a tighter constraint on the pace of investment.
